note: Step 3a: process as the matching entry says, BYPASS, DISCARD or PROTECT. PROTECT: the datagram reaches the remote endpoint as ESP carrying the Child SA outbound SPI, no XfrmOutNoStates. BYPASS: delivered in the clear, and no ESP copy on the raw socket. DISCARD: operator DISCARD entry refuses the write with EPERM, XfrmOutPolBlock +1, not delivered. All three dispositions asserted on kernel counters and delivery; AH is not installed by IKE (ESP only), so the PROTECT case is ESP. Records: producer revert red both polarities; overlays discard->ALLOW and bypass->BLOCK each redden exactly the unit that asserts that disposition.
